decision: Random Forest promoted as primary per architecture.md §2: models are statistically indistinguishable on this noisy dataset (test RMSE 43.20 vs 43.30 min, r2 0.13 vs 0.12; 5-fold CV RMSE 41.90 vs 41.71).
